title: Where the Error Lives: Separating Lid-Edge and Body-Induced Error in Neural Pressure Prediction for 3D Cavity Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.19741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a pressure surrogate score much better globally without better resolving the pressure around immersed bodies? We test this in a three-dimensional lid-driven cavity with an unregularized lid and centered pressure at native $128^3$ resolution. On 60 cases from 12 unseen geometries, with predictions sealed before the CFD truth existed, adding a body-free, Reynolds-conditioned reference correction to the same frozen $64^3$ surrogate lifted to $128^3$ lowers the mean full-volume relative $L_2$ error from 20.6% to 7.5%. In the post hoc regional analysis, the lid-edge junction occupies 1.5% of the fluid but holds 69% of the truth pressure energy and 95% of the uncorrected surrogate's squared error. Interior error changes by just +0.16% relative, and object-local peak error and recall change little on average. Retrospective ablations locate the learned term's contribution in the interior and near the bodies; rebasing on the reference lower

translated_title: 误差藏身何处：在三维腔体流的神经压力预测中分离盖板边缘误差与物体诱导误差
translated_abstract: 压力代理模型能否在不更精细地解析浸没物体周围压力的情况下，在整体评分上大幅提升？我们在一个具有未正则化盖板和居中压力的三维盖驱动腔体中，以原生 128³ 分辨率对此进行测试。在来自 12 个未见几何构型的 60 个算例上（预测结果在 CFD 真值生成之前就已封存），在同一个冻结的 64³ 代理模型上添加一个无物体、依赖雷诺数的参考修正并提升至 128³，可将平均全域相对 L₂ 误差从 20.6% 降至 7.5%。在事后区域分析中，盖板边缘连接区仅占流体体积的 1.5%，却承载了 69% 的真实压力能量以及未修正代理模型 95% 的平方误差。内部区域误差的相对变化仅为 +0.16%，物体局部的峰值误差和召回率平均变化也很小。回溯性消融实验将学习项的贡献定位于内部区域和物体附近；基于参考的重新基准化降低了……
tldr: 研究发现三维盖驱动腔体神经压力预测的误差主要集中于仅占流体体积1.5%却贡献95%平方误差的盖板边缘区域，并通过添加无物体、雷诺数条件化的参考修正，将冻结的64³代理模型的全域相对L₂误差从20.6%降至7.5%，同时几乎不改变物体周围的局部误差。
en_tdlr: A body-free, Reynolds-conditioned reference correction lifts a frozen 64³ neural pressure surrogate from 20.6% to 7.5% full-volume relative L₂ error in 3D lid-driven cavity flow, revealing that the lid-edge junction—just 1.5% of the fluid volume—harbors 95% of the surrogate's squared error while object-local errors barely change.
